title: Aadhaar Experience
description: In this video, Ramani Dalbehera, a speaker of the Sora language of India and a resident of Rayagada district from the Odisha state, discusses her experience with Aadhaar, India's biometric ID. Dalbehera was interviewed in 2019 by Opino Gomango and Subhashish Panigrahi for the latter's 2021 documentary film, MarginalizedAadhaar. The interview took place in Sora with Gomango, in the presence of Namad Dalbehera, another Lanjia-Sora speaker who is related to Ramani. Gomango asked more detailed and nuanced questions based on the broader questions/structure set by Panigrahi in Odia. Unused or trimmed archival footage from the film was edited by Panigrahi and published under the OpenSpeaks Archives project in 2026. English subtitles by Gomango, and edits and Odia subtitles are by Panigrahi.
